datasets.name: ACTIVSg2000 synthetic Texas grid
datasets.license: Free commercial and non-commercial use with attribution; verify upstream terms
datasets.use: Primary Texas-shaped synthetic power-flow case and substation coordinates
datasets.caveat: Fully synthetic and not the actual ERCOT network

datasets.name: EAGLE-I county outages, 2021
datasets.license: Public research dataset; retain ORNL citation and upstream terms
datasets.use: Fifteen-minute county customers-out labels
datasets.caveat: Utility coverage varies over time and geography

datasets.name: EAGLE-I county outages, 2025
datasets.license: Public research dataset; retain ORNL citation and upstream terms
datasets.use: Recent county customers-out observations
datasets.caveat: Coverage is not a complete census of utility outages

datasets.name: NOAA High-Resolution Rapid Refresh
datasets.use: Hourly 3 km weather analysis and forecasts
datasets.caveat: Multi-terabyte archive; subset Texas, variables, levels, and event windows

datasets.name: NOAA Storm Events Database
datasets.use: Historical damaging-weather event labels
datasets.caveat: Reporting completeness and publication lag vary by event type and year

datasets.name: NHC HURDAT2 best-track archive
datasets.use: Six-hourly historical hurricane tracks and intensity
datasets.caveat: Archive filenames change when a new season is incorporated

datasets.name: NOAA Climate Data Online
datasets.use: Station observations and climate records
datasets.caveat: API token and explicit station/date selection may be required

datasets.name: EIA-860 generator inventory, 2024
datasets.use: Generator, plant, capacity, status, cooling, and environmental attributes
datasets.caveat: Annual snapshot; use EIA-860M for newer status changes

datasets.name: EIA-860M monthly generator inventory
datasets.use: Recent generator additions, retirements, and status
datasets.caveat: Preliminary monthly data can be revised

datasets.name: EIA-923 power plant operations
datasets.use: Plant generation, fuel consumption, stocks, receipts, and emissions inputs
datasets.caveat: Monthly and annual releases have different finality

datasets.name: EIA-930 hourly balancing-authority operations
datasets.use: Hourly demand, demand forecast, generation by fuel, and interchange
datasets.caveat: Balancing-authority aggregates are not nodal telemetry

datasets.name: EIA-861 utility and reliability data
datasets.use: Utilities, customers, AMI, service territories, SAIDI, and SAIFI
datasets.caveat: Annual utility-reported metrics; review EIA correction notices

datasets.name: EIA-411 reliability planning
datasets.use: Regional capacity adequacy and reliability planning
datasets.caveat: Planning data is regional rather than asset-level operational truth

datasets.name: PUDL nightly EIA-860 plants Parquet
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 for PUDL outputs; underlying source terms also apply
datasets.use: Cleaned, typed EIA plant data
datasets.caveat: Nightly outputs can change; pin a stable release for reproducibility

datasets.name: ERCOT historical load
datasets.use: Texas load history by weather zone
datasets.caveat: Public aggregates do not reveal complete grid topology

datasets.name: ERCOT generation and resource data
datasets.use: Fuel mix, renewable forecasts, resource outages, and constraints
datasets.caveat: Some MIS products require credentials or market-participant access

datasets.name: ERCOT market prices and LMPs
datasets.use: Real-time and settlement prices for congestion proxies
datasets.caveat: Market nodes must not be assumed to map directly to synthetic buses

datasets.name: ERCOT transmission and resource planning
datasets.use: Projected load, constraints, transmission projects, and costs
datasets.caveat: Planning reports are not a complete power-flow case

datasets.name: HIFLD electric transmission lines
datasets.license: US government public-data terms; verify distribution metadata
datasets.use: Real-world line geometry for map context and proximity features
datasets.caveat: Stale in places and not verified electrical connectivity or ratings

datasets.name: DOE hourly dynamic line ratings
datasets.license: US government public-data terms; verify package metadata
datasets.use: Estimated static, ambient-adjusted, and dynamic ratings for HIFLD lines
datasets.caveat: Modeled 2007-2013 ratings, not operator telemetry

datasets.name: FERC Form 714 balancing-authority data
datasets.use: Balancing-authority generation, transfers, and load history
datasets.caveat: Form 714 is public; do not confuse it with restricted Form 715

datasets.name: FERC Form 715 transmission planning cases
datasets.use: Recorded only to document the unavailable real-network source
datasets.caveat: Not publicly downloadable; never attempt to bypass CEII controls

datasets.name: FEMA National Risk Index county table v1.20
datasets.use: County-level natural-hazard risk, resilience, and vulnerability features
datasets.caveat: Composite screening index, not site-specific engineering analysis; the legacy ZIP currently returns HTTP 403 to scripted clients

datasets.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
datasets.use: Flood zones and effective flood-map features
datasets.caveat: Coverage and effective dates vary by community; query only the study area

datasets.name: USGS earthquake feeds and hazard services
datasets.use: Observed earthquakes and seismic hazard
datasets.caveat: Separate event feeds from probabilistic hazard-model outputs

datasets.name: US Drought Monitor GIS
datasets.use: Weekly drought-severity polygons
datasets.caveat: Use authoritative vector products rather than display rasters for analysis

datasets.name: Wildfire Risk to Communities
datasets.license: US government public data with requested attribution
datasets.use: State-level burn probability and risk-to-homes layers
datasets.caveat: Modeled risk, not incident prediction

datasets.name: USFS Wildfire Hazard Potential
datasets.use: National 270 m wildfire-hazard raster
datasets.caveat: Long-term hazard indicator, not a current fire perimeter

datasets.name: EPA RE-Powering Mapper
datasets.use: Brownfields, landfills, mines, and contaminated-land candidate sites
datasets.caveat: Screening data is not site verification and includes older criteria vintages

datasets.name: USGS Protected Areas Database of the US
datasets.use: Protected-land exclusion and stewardship status
datasets.caveat: Version-to-version area totals are not directly comparable

datasets.name: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory
datasets.use: Wetland and deepwater exclusion layers
datasets.caveat: Not a regulatory jurisdiction determination

datasets.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program
datasets.use: Elevation, slope, terrain, and drainage proxies
datasets.caveat: Select a consistent resolution and vertical datum

datasets.name: Annual National Land Cover Database
datasets.use: Annual 30 m land cover, impervious surface, and tree canopy
datasets.caveat: Raster archive is large; clip to candidate buffers

datasets.name: Census TIGER/Line counties, 2024
datasets.use: County boundaries and FIPS joins
datasets.caveat: Use matching geographic vintages when joining census attributes

datasets.name: American Community Survey API
datasets.use: Population, demographics, income, housing, and vulnerability features
datasets.caveat: Margins of error matter, especially for small geographies

datasets.name: CMS Hospital General Information
datasets.use: Current hospital names, addresses, ownership, and classifications
datasets.caveat: Geocode addresses or reconcile against another spatial source

datasets.name: EPA Public Water System Service Areas
datasets.use: Community and non-community drinking-water service boundaries
datasets.caveat: Many boundaries are modeled rather than utility-certified

datasets.name: EPA ECHO facility downloads
datasets.use: Geocoded regulated facilities including water-system records
datasets.caveat: Regulatory facility presence is only a proxy for critical electric load

datasets.name: NTAD military-base boundaries, Texas
datasets.license: CC0 / US government public data per service metadata
datasets.use: Publicly releasable military-installation boundaries
datasets.caveat: Not a comprehensive inventory of sensitive or restricted facilities

datasets.name: RTS-GMLC reliability test system
datasets.use: Small benchmark with hourly and five-minute operations data
datasets.caveat: Synthetic benchmark, not Texas geography

datasets.name: PyPSA-USA
datasets.license: MIT for code; upstream data licenses vary
datasets.use: Reproducible national zonal and synthetic nodal grid construction
datasets.caveat: Modeled network; review every upstream dataset license

datasets.name: Microsoft GridSFM models and data pipeline
datasets.license: Review model, code, and underlying public-data licenses separately
datasets.use: Public OPF-solvable state and regional synthetic models
datasets.caveat: New research release; validate methodology before production use

datasets.name: NREL Annual Technology Baseline
datasets.use: Generation and storage technology cost and performance assumptions
datasets.caveat: Scenario assumptions are not project quotes

datasets.name: NREL Cambium
datasets.use: Modeled hourly grid costs, emissions, and futures through 2050
datasets.caveat: Scenario output, not an operational forecast

datasets.name: EPA eGRID
datasets.use: Plant generation, emissions, heat input, and resource mix
datasets.caveat: Annual accounting data is not real-time dispatch telemetry

datasets.name: LBNL Queued Up interconnection queues
datasets.license: Review LBNL data-use and citation terms
datasets.use: Cleaned project-level interconnection queues across grid operators
datasets.caveat: Queue presence does not imply a project will be built

datasets.name: LBNL generator interconnection costs
datasets.license: Review LBNL data-use and citation terms
datasets.use: Project-level network-upgrade and interconnection cost benchmarks
datasets.caveat: Historical study costs do not replace a new interconnection study

datasets.name: NRC operating-reactor datasets
datasets.use: Reactor status, events, inspections, scrams, and operating history
datasets.caveat: Operating-reactor records do not establish suitability for a new site

datasets.name: NERC GADS public statistics
datasets.use: Aggregate generating-unit outage-rate calibration
datasets.caveat: Raw unit-level records are not generally public

datasets.name: NERC TADS public statistics
datasets.use: Aggregate transmission outage-rate calibration
datasets.caveat: Raw element-level outage records are not generally public
